title: Free Time
text:
I like to spend my free time outside. On Saturday I go to the park with my friends. We play football and ride bikes. Sometimes we just sit and talk.

On Sunday I stay at home. I read books and draw pictures. My sister likes to play games on the computer. In the evening we watch a film together.

questions.text: Where does the writer go on Saturday?
What does the writer do on Sunday?
What kind of person is the writer most likely to be?
options: Someone who enjoys spending time with friends
Someone who does not like sport

questions.text: Why does the writer's family watch a film together in the evening?
options: They want to spend time together

vocabulary.definition: in the open air, not inside a building
a sport played by two teams with a round ball and goals
to make a picture with a pencil or pen
with another person or other people

paragraph_translations: Lubię spędzać wolny czas na dworze. W sobotę idę do parku z przyjaciółmi. Gramy w piłkę nożną i jeździmy na rowerach. Czasami po prostu siedzimy i rozmawiamy.
W niedzielę zostaję w domu. Czytam książki i rysuję obrazki. Moja siostra lubi grać w gry na komputerze. Wieczorem razem oglądamy film.
